name: prompt-engineering-exam-assistant
title_zh: 截图喂题，直接吐出带格式要求的JSON答案
tagline_zh: 对着屏幕上的Prompt工程题发愁？拍下来或贴文字，它按你要求的输出格式算好分类/计算题，JSON直接抄。
tagline_en: Stuck on a rule-based prompt exercise? Snap or paste it—get the exact JSON output, formatted to spec, ready to.
desc_en: Solve rule-based Prompt engineering exercises from screenshots or text when the required final answer is structured JSON. Use when the user asks to create, revise, or debug a calculation or classification Prompt with exact output formatting.
why_zh: 不靠猜。它先拆解题目里的规则约束，再按你指定的JSON结构一步步推导，连格式错误都帮你避开。
why_en: No guessing. It parses the rule constraints, then derives the answer step-by-step into your exact JSON schema—format errors.
limit_zh: 只认规则明确的Prompt工程题（计算/分类），且最终答案必须是结构化JSON。自由写作、开放式问答。
limit_en: Only rule-based prompt exercises (calculation/classification) with structured JSON output. Free-form, open-ended, or knowledge-heavy tasks—it refuses.
title_en: Turn exercise screenshots into exact JSON answers
